THE CALLER ALSO SAYS SOMETIMES THERE IS 4-5" OF PET COKE IN THE CARS WHEN THEY GO TO CLEAN THEM, WHICH SHOULD BE SENT BACK TO THE COMPANY BUT IS INSTEAD WASHED OUT ON SITE. THE CALLER REPORTS THE PET COKE BECOMES AIRBORNE. THE CALLER REPORTS THESE TRACKS ARE ON PRIVATE PROPERTY AND NOT PART OF THE FEDERAL RAIL SYSTEM.
